<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.05in; text-align: center"><B>CERTIFICATE OF LIMITED PARTNERSHIP</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.05in; text-align: center"><B>&nbsp;</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.05in; text-align: center"><B>OF</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.05in; text-align: center"><B>&nbsp;</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.05in; text-align: center"><B>Macquarie Energy Transition Infrastructure
Fund, L.P.</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.05in; text-align: justify; text-indent: 1in">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0in; text-align: justify; text-indent: 1in">The undersigned, desiring
to form a limited partnership pursuant to the Delaware Revised Uniform Limited Partnership Act, <U>6 Del. C.</U> &sect;&sect; 17-101
<U>et</U> <U>seq</U>., hereby certifies as follows:</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.05in; text-align: justify; text-indent: 1in">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0in; text-align: justify; text-indent: 1in">FIRST. The name of
the limited partnership formed hereby is Macquarie Energy Transition Infrastructure Fund, L.P. (the &ldquo;<U>Partnership</U>&rdquo;).</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.05in; text-align: justify; text-indent: 1in">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0in; text-align: justify; text-indent: 1in">SECOND. The address
of the Partnership&rsquo;s registered office in the State of Delaware is c/o Corporation Trust Company, 1209 Orange St, Wilmington, Delaware
19808. The name and address of the Partnership&rsquo;s registered agent for service of process on the Partnership is Corporation Trust
Company, 1209 Orange St, Wilmington, Delaware 19808.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.05in; text-align: justify; text-indent: 1in">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0in; text-align: justify; text-indent: 1in">THIRD. The name and
mailing address of the general partner of the Partnership is as follows:</P>
